rationale: One unresolved design question (whether padStart/padEnd belong in the schema or callers pre-pad their audio) whose answer changes the file list.

signals.blast_radius: Four subsystems touched: schema gains optional audio field, audio module adds ffmpeg-backed decoder, render pipeline Step A modified to choose between synthesis and decode paths, captions handler modified to skip external audio scenes; ~10 files total
signals.unresolved: Whether padStart/padEnd live in the schema or callers pre-pad; answering no removes those fields from the schema entirely. Two other questions (fixed 24 kHz vs adaptive decode rate, captions behavior) are tuning knobs whose answers do not change what is built.
signals.irreversibility: Pure git revert with no data migration; the audio field is optional and backward-compatible, new code path activates only when field is present, existing specs render identically
